SPRING 2027 / COURSE

Essence Therapy Level II

Based on the first level, deepen the understanding and practice of inner work.

Essence Therapy · Deepen

Course at a Glance

On the basis of the first level, further study age regression, emotional transformation and cognitive restructuring, and deepen the method through group exercises, case demonstrations and on-site supervision feedback.

Who is suitable to study

Partners who have already learned the basics of Essence Therapy Level I and want to continue to deepen the method practice. The specific learning basis can be consulted before registration.

What to learn in the course

  • Based on the existing foundation, deepen the process of moving from physical sensation to inner work.
  • Learn age regression, emotion transformation and cognitive restructuring and other methods.
  • Through case demonstrations, observe how these methods can be used in specific work situations.
  • Combine group exercises with on-site supervision feedback to identify key links in operations.

learning style

A combination of group exercises, case demonstrations and on-site supervision feedback. The course emphasizes understanding methods, practicing operations and obtaining feedback in specific situations.

learning objectives

Based on the existing first-order experience, improve the observation and understanding of the inner process and continue to practice the application of methods.

What can I learn next?

Method learning requires continuous practice and feedback; it can be consolidated through reading, practice and supervision.

Related works: Embracing the Inner Parent and Child (《内在父母与内在小孩的拥抱》) ↗
